description: The file 'ProcessDuplicates.php' is part of a CRM system (vtiger CRM) and handles duplicate record processing, including merging and transferring related records within the Contacts module.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine class specific to vtiger CRM used for rendering views.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from duplicate or old records to the primary record during merge.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes the specified entity record from the database.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Retrieves record values for given record IDs for use in merge operations.
